criteria.statement: A stalled relay publication does not block Bootstrapper from establishing a subscription against the same managed relay.
The relay adapter remains free of data races while publication, subscription, and active-subscription bookkeeping execute concurrently.
The production Bahia image builds through the repository Dockerfile after the lock-boundary change.
A guarded production canary reaches tier-3 readiness and sustains the relay-amplification task's ten-minute steady-state acceptance window.
